name: CVInfotech Importer for Shopify and WooCommerce
author: CV Infotech

sections.description:
CVInfotech Importer for Shopify and WooCommerce is a professional Shopify to WooCommerce product importer that helps you import products from Shopify to WooCommerce effortlessly. Migrate Shopify to WooCommerce from any Shopify store worldwide with this powerful Shopify migration plugin. Perfect for Shopify export to WooCommerce, transfer Shopify products, Shopify data migration, and complete Shopify store migration. Version 3.0.0 is completely rebuilt for reliability, simplicity, and proper variable product handling.

Looking to migrate from Shopify to WordPress WooCommerce? Need to move from Shopify to WordPress? This is the perfect Shopify product import solution for e-commerce store owners who want to import Shopify products to WooCommerce without technical complexity. Whether you’re doing a bulk import from Shopify, automated Shopify import, copy products from Shopify, or complete Shopify WooCommerce sync, this Shopify import tool handles it all.

Switch from Shopify to WooCommerce easily with this free Shopify to WordPress importer. Our plugin works as a Shopify product export tool, WooCommerce import plugin, and complete Shopify migration tool for WordPress users.

Key Features

  • Import Products from Shopify to WooCommerce – Seamlessly import unlimited products from any Shopify store
  • Universal Shopify Compatibility – Works with ANY Shopify store worldwide, perfect for Shopify to WooCommerce migration
  • Variable Products Import – Properly imports product variations with attributes (sizes, colors, etc.)
  • Complete Product Data Migration – Imports titles, descriptions, prices, SKUs, sale prices, and compare-at prices
  • Automatic Image Import – Downloads and imports all Shopify product images to WooCommerce media library
  • Smart Product Categorization – Automatically assigns brands, categories, and tags during Shopify product import
  • Flexible Taxonomy Mapping – Import Shopify tags or set your own default brands, categories, and tags
  • Simple & Fast Migration – Clean interface, no complicated settings, migrate Shopify products in minutes
  • Update Support – Safely updates existing products without duplicating during re-import
  • Reliable Product Importer – No timeouts, proper error handling for large Shopify catalogs
  • Professional Code Standards – Clean code following WordPress and WooCommerce best practices

Perfect For

  • E-commerce businesses looking to migrate from Shopify to WooCommerce or switch from Shopify to WordPress
  • Store owners who need to import products from Shopify to WooCommerce quickly using a reliable Shopify import tool
  • Agencies managing Shopify to WordPress WooCommerce migrations and Shopify data migration for clients
  • Businesses moving from Shopify to WordPress or switching from Shopify to self-hosted WooCommerce platforms
  • Developers needing Shopify export to WooCommerce functionality or bulk import Shopify products
  • Store owners with large product catalogs needing reliable Shopify product import and transfer Shopify products capability
  • Anyone seeking a professional Shopify to WooCommerce product importer or Shopify migration plugin
  • Users wanting to clone Shopify store to WooCommerce or copy products from Shopify to WordPress
  • Merchants looking for Shopify alternative solutions with WooCommerce import capabilities

How to Import Products from Shopify to WooCommerce

  1. Access your Shopify store’s products JSON URL (e.g., yourstore.myshopify.com/products.json)
  2. Install and activate this Shopify to WooCommerce importer plugin
  3. Navigate to Shopify Import in your WordPress admin dashboard
  4. Enter your Shopify products JSON URL
  5. Click “Run Import Now” to start the Shopify product migration
  6. All products, variations, images, and attributes are automatically imported to WooCommerce

Why Choose This Shopify to WooCommerce Importer?

  • Easy Shopify Migration – No technical skills required to migrate Shopify products to WooCommerce or transfer Shopify store data
  • Complete Data Transfer – Imports all product data, perfect for Shopify export to WooCommerce including variations, attributes, and images
  • Time-Saving Import Tool – Import hundreds of products from Shopify to WooCommerce in minutes with bulk import capability
  • Safe & Secure Migration – No data sent to third-party services, everything happens on your server during Shopify data migration
  • Free WooCommerce Import Solution – Professional Shopify to WooCommerce migration without expensive subscription fees or Shopify export costs
  • Shopify Alternative Ready – Perfect for businesses moving from Shopify to WooCommerce or switching ecommerce platforms
  • Automated Import – Set up one-time or recurring Shopify product imports to WooCommerce
  • Clone Shopify Store – Duplicate your entire Shopify product catalog to WordPress WooCommerce
  • Regular Updates – Actively maintained Shopify import plugin improved for latest WordPress & WooCommerce versions

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin installed and activated
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Sufficient server memory for large imports

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support page or contact us at support@cvinfotech.com.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All data processing happens locally on your WordPress installation.

Credits

Developed by CVInfotech – Your trusted WordPress development partner.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “CVInfotech Importer Shopify WooCommerce“
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  5. Go to Shopify Import menu to start importing products from Shopify to WooCommerce

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory and extract
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  4. Navigate to Shopify Import in your WordPress admin menu
  5. Enter your Shopify products JSON URL and click ‘Run Import Now’

Getting Started with Shopify Product Import

  1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  2. Go to Settings > Shopify Import to configure default brands, categories, and tags (optional)
  3. Get your Shopify JSON URL (usually: yourstore.myshopify.com/products.json)
  4. Paste the URL in the import page and start migration
sections.faq:
How do I import products from Shopify to WooCommerce?

Simply install this Shopify to WooCommerce product importer, get your Shopify products JSON URL (e.g., yourstore.myshopify.com/products.json), paste it into the Shopify Import page, and click “Run Import Now”. The plugin will automatically migrate Shopify to WooCommerce, transfer Shopify products, and complete the Shopify export to WooCommerce process in minutes.

Is this a free Shopify to WooCommerce product importer?

Yes! This is a completely free Shopify to WooCommerce migration plugin with no hidden fees or premium upgrades required.

Do I need WooCommerce installed to migrate Shopify products?

Yes, this Shopify to WooCommerce importer requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated as it imports products directly into your WooCommerce store.

Can I import Shopify variable products with attributes?

Absolutely! The plugin fully supports importing both simple and variable products from Shopify, including all product variations, attributes (sizes, colors, etc.), and their respective prices.

Will product images be imported from Shopify?

Yes, all Shopify product images are automatically downloaded and imported to your WordPress media library. The first image becomes the featured image, and additional images are added to the product gallery.

Can I update existing WooCommerce products during Shopify import?

Yes, the plugin intelligently checks for existing products by SKU or title. If a match is found, it updates the product instead of creating duplicates.

What Shopify data gets imported to WooCommerce?

The importer migrates: product titles, descriptions, prices, sale prices, SKUs, images, product variations, attributes, vendors (as brands), product types (as categories), and tags.

Does this work with any Shopify store?

Yes! This Shopify to WooCommerce product importer works with ANY Shopify store worldwide, regardless of your Shopify plan or store size.

Can I customize how products are categorized during import?

Yes! Go to Settings > Shopify Import to configure default brands, categories, and tags. You can choose to use Shopify’s data or set your own defaults.

How long does it take to import products from Shopify to WooCommerce?

Shopify to WooCommerce migration speed depends on your catalog size and server performance. Most stores complete bulk import from Shopify of hundreds of products within minutes. The Shopify import tool handles large catalogs without timeout errors during Shopify data migration.

Is my Shopify data safe during migration?

Absolutely! This Shopify migration plugin only reads data from your Shopify JSON URL. It doesn’t modify or delete anything on your Shopify store. All Shopify export to WooCommerce processing happens securely on your WordPress server.

Can I use this to switch from Shopify to WooCommerce permanently?

Yes! This plugin is perfect for businesses moving from Shopify to WordPress permanently. It handles complete Shopify store migration, allowing you to transfer Shopify products, copy products from Shopify, and clone your Shopify store to WooCommerce. Many users successfully use this as their primary Shopify to WordPress importer when leaving Shopify for WooCommerce.

Does this work as a Shopify export tool?

Yes! This functions as a comprehensive Shopify product export tool and WooCommerce import plugin. It handles Shopify export to WooCommerce, bulk import Shopify products, and complete Shopify data migration to WordPress.

Is this better than paid Shopify migration tools?

This free Shopify to WooCommerce product importer offers professional-grade Shopify migration capabilities without subscription fees. Unlike expensive Shopify import tools, our plugin provides automated Shopify import, Shopify WooCommerce sync, and reliable transfer Shopify products functionality at no cost.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Complete Rebuild: Professional, clean codebase
  • Fixed: Variable products now import correctly with proper attributes and variations
  • Removed: PDF handling feature (not needed for most users)
  • Removed: BTU extraction feature (HVAC-specific, not universal)
  • Removed: Specifications tab feature (unnecessary complexity)
  • Improved: Simplified settings page – only brand, category, tag options
  • Improved: Better variable product attribute handling
  • Improved: Cleaner import process with better feedback
  • Improved: More reliable – no timeouts on large imports
  • Changed: Focus on core Shopify to WooCommerce migration
  • Updated: All descriptions to reflect actual plugin functionality

2.7.0

  • Major Update: Complete Settings Page
  • New: Works with ANY Shopify store (universal compatibility)
  • New: Configure default brand, category, and tag assignments

2.6.1

  • Fixed: WordPress.org compliance – unique function names
  • Updated: All functions use cvinfotech_swi_ prefix

2.6

  • Initial release
